text: Ensembled consultancy averages the results of two single consultancies in which the consultant argues each of the two possible answers, which the authors say should in theory improve judge accuracy by correcting calibration errors such as sycophancy or learned misleading persuasion. Double consultancy is similar except that both sets of consultant speeches are presented to the judge in one context, allowing an explicit comparison of the arguments to produce a single judgment.
title: Ensembled and double consultancy: pairwise-comparison consultancy variants
